content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIPER Guwahati Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIPER Guwahati to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Guwahati (NIPER Guwahati) for project-based research positions.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification advertises positions for Project Scientist-III and Project Scientist-II under a Department of Health Research (DHR) sponsored project.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced, with 1 vacancy allocated for Project Scientist-III and 1 vacancy for Project Scientist-II.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 8 October 2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Scientist-III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist-III position will receive a salary of Rs. 78,000 plus HRA amounting to Rs. 15,600.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Scientist-II?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Scientist-II position will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000 plus HRA amounting to Rs. 13,400.

faq.question: Q7. What are the age limits for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years for Project Scientist-III and 40 years for Project Scientist-II applicants.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualifications are required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree or Pharm.D or Ph.D. in relevant fields like Pharmacy Practice, Clinical Pharmacy, Pharmacology, Public Health, Biostatistics, or Health Economics with required experience.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply online by filling out the Google Form provided in the official notification and keeping all supporting scanned documents ready.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of application data followed by a hybrid mode interview conducted both physically and online.
